subject: Re: Kickoff: Agile Deliberation — concept deliberation for subjective visual classification
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Yusuf leads at 70%, Nikhil 50% on the deliberation loop, Quentin 30% on rater UX. The Laion400M slice is full of near-duplicates, which poisons the borderline-example queue, so we are scoping and staffing a dataset de-duplication pipeline built from scratch — Giannis owns the build at 50% through April.

Compute: faiss-gpu on 4 A100s for index build and retrieval; the faiss-cpu fallback is fine for notebook demos. Storage ask into Corpus for the index shards is ~3TB — quota request is filed.

Sequencing note: dedup has to finish before the pilot, otherwise raters see the same borderline image four times and the agreement numbers are garbage.

Bao
